note: Beaver County campground by Camp Lake, about 18 km east of Viking, run by a county contractor: sites along two roads and a south loop, plus 11 extra-large G sites, behind a treeline from the shore; from 2026 sites 43-55 are sold only as seasonals. The two swim beaches and the boat launch are day-use areas. Sites 1-21 take a 2-night minimum online, while the rest sell single nights. --Claude
